subject: SCIENCE
title: Five Sense Helpers
objective: Connect primary sense organs with observations while recognizing senses work together.
introduction: Milo hears a bird, smells a mango, and feels a cool breeze. Which sense organs give him each clue?

vocabulary.definition: A way your body learns about the world through an organ.
A vibration that travels to your ears and lets you hear.
Using your ears to notice sounds around you.

activities.instruction: Watch Milo connect each sense organ with its job.
activities.content: Eyes, ears, nose, tongue, and skin are primary helpers, and senses often work together.

feedback.retry: Check the clue: eyes see, ears hear, the nose smells, the tongue tastes, and skin feels.

items.prompt: Milo hears a bird and smells a mango. Which statement about senses is true?

options.text: Eyes, ears, nose, tongue, and skin are primary helpers, and senses often work together.
Taste works without smell in every way
Each sense organ works alone all the time

items.explanation: Eyes, ears, nose, tongue, and skin each help you sense, and they can work together. Smell helps flavor, and people may sense the same event differently.

items.prompt: Maxine sees a rainbow through a window. Which pair matches an organ to its job?
items.explanation: Eyes detect light and color, which is why Maxine can notice a rainbow. Ears detect sound, the tongue tastes, and the nose smells.

items.prompt: Milo writes four claims about senses. Which one is NOT true?

options.text: Taste works without smell in every way
Skin can feel a cool breeze

items.explanation: Taste and smell work together, so taste is often weaker when you cannot smell. Eyes, ears, and skin still have the jobs named in the other cards.

items.prompt: A bell rings beside Maxine. Which organ primarily detects the sound?
items.explanation: Ears receive sound vibrations from the bell. Eyes notice light, the tongue tastes, and the nose detects smells.

items.prompt: Maxine feels a soft blanket with her hand. Which pair matches the organ to the clue?
items.explanation: Skin detects touch, so it helps Maxine feel the blanket. Ears detect sound, and eyes detect light.
